## Overview

The portable contract for cutting a triangle mesh with a plane: limits,
section contours, evidence, and conformance suites. It computes nothing
itself; providers implement `MeshPlaneSection`, and `axiolid-dispatch`
selects one. `section` returns closed contours and refuses a face lying in the
plane (ADR 0033). `section_request` is the opt-in alternative: a face in the
plane comes back as a region with a side, cut curves are transversal chains
that may end on a region, and touching edges are counted (ADR 0091). With
`SectionRole::Sheet` the mesh may be open, and a chain may end on the mesh
boundary. `SectionRequest::with_cut_regions` also returns the cut of a solid,
where its material lies on both sides of the plane, as closed regions (ADR
0092).

## Changes

Latest release, 0.3.6 (2026-10-29):

### Changed

- Documentation of `CutRegion`: the invariant that rings never cross, and the
  exactness section, now say that the decisions are made on exact source
  points (source vertices in the plane and exact crossings of source edges),
  and that the returned points are those computed in binary64, so rings that
  touch may cross by rounding error (ADR 0092, #377).
